articles.headline: Just tuning in for World Cup final? Let's catch you up on what you've missed
articles.description: For those who are just tuning in, here are the highlights of the World Cup so far, from Lionel Messi heroics and underdog upsets to brave USMNT performances.

articles.headline: Who is Slavko Vincic? Spain vs. Argentina referee for World Cup final drew Real Madrid backlash, Jose Mourinho praise
articles.description: Slovenian referee Slavko Vincic will officiate the World Cup final between Spain and Argentina on Sunday. But who is he, what's his record, and what have been his major moments?

articles.headline: Messi first met Yamal as a baby. The World Cup final will be their next meeting
articles.description: Little did Lionel Messi know when he picked up the baby Lamine Yamal two decades ago that he was holding a future World Cup final opponent in his arms.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino to make decision on USMNT future next week
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino has said he will make a decision regarding his future as coach of the United States national team next week.

articles.headline: Declan Rice 'might be a centre-half' - Graeme Souness
articles.description: Declan Rice might be better suited to playing in defence because of his "limited" passing range, according to Graeme Souness.

articles.headline: World Cup winners to be awarded 'championship rings'
articles.description: The winners of the World Cup will be awarded championship rings in addition to the traditional trophy and gold medals.
